The matched baseline c6c3d40d310b (same pool, same guide, same model, context removed) scores 35.5%, so the true aggregate context effect on 200 rows is +1.0 point, i.e. nothing.

Methodological point: when an intervention only touches a small subset of rows, the untouched rows are a free within-experiment control. Reading the aggregate headline discards that control and is what let the pool change masquerade as an effect. Always report the treated-vs-untreated difference-in-differences.

conclusions.statement: Ancestor-context repair fixes 132 of the 580 hierarchy-inconsistent production rows with zero detector regressions, and selective adoption gets the same benefit from 131 edits instead of 228.
conclusions.detail:
Applied to the 5,012-row imaging deliverable and scored IN CONTEXT (spliced back into the full batch, same detectors, run 6e366a325751):

  hierarchy-flagged rows   580 -> 448   (132 fixed, 0 newly broken)
  blockers                  76 -> 76
  contrast-fidelity issues   4 -> 4
  new translation collisions               0

The subset repair's OWN hierarchy number (90.3%) is meaningless and must not be quoted: run over 341 rows in isolation only 31 of the batch's 1,774 containment pairs survive, because a repaired row's ancestor is usually outside the subset. That is what the splice_translations node exists to fix.

Selective adoption is strictly better than wholesale. Of the 228 rows the repair changed, only 132 cleared a flag; the other 96 carried the intervention's regression risk with no measured benefit. Restricting the splice to the rows whose flag actually cleared keeps all 132 fixes for 131 edits. Pair-level inconsistency is marginally worse under selection (29.82% vs 28.97%) because the withheld edits did fix ~15 additional PAIRS on rows that stay flagged regardless — not worth 97 unnecessary changes to the deliverable.

The adopted changes are overwhelmingly register normalisation aligning siblings to a shared ancestor: 견갑골 -> 어깨빨, 고관절 -> 엉덩이, 뒤오목 -> 후두개, 수술중 투시 -> 수술중 투시 유도하. Direction is set by whichever form the ancestor chose, so this is a consistency intervention, not a register policy.

conclusions.statement: Hierarchy consistency rewards copying an ancestor whether or not the ancestor is right, so a consistency repair needs an independent correctness gate.
conclusions.detail:
The first ancestor repair (run 77ad3633b851) improved every consistency metric while REVERSING two correct 팔 renderings into the SME-rejected 위팔, introducing 엉덩이 on a hip CT, and generalising 주상골 (scaphoid) to 손목빨 (carpal). Each change made the descendant agree with its ancestor, which is exactly what the metric scores.

The existing strict ancestor filter could not catch these. It excludes ancestors that are non-unanimous, blocker-violating, self-inconsistent or repeated-token — but unlike the malformed 439101006 case it was built for, these ancestors are fluent, unanimous and clean. They are simply wrong in a way only a reviewer's ruling defines.

Two independent gates fixed it, and both were needed:
  1. SOURCE — encode the SME's rulings as blocker-severity rules, which makes build_ancestor_context refuse those ancestors as teaching context (342 -> 341 admitted, blocker-excluded 2 -> 4).
  2. ADOPTION — splice_translations refuses any patch row that INTRODUCES a blocker the base row did not have. Necessary because the model still emits 위팔 unprompted: 2 rows were refused at adoption even after no ancestor taught it.

Result: 3 of the 4 defective rows are now caught automatically. The survivor is the specificity loss (주상골 -> 손목빨), which is a distinct failure class with no detector — the repair erases a distinction the English preserves while improving the metric. It produced no collision, so it is one row, but a specificity-loss detector is the natural next node.

conclusions.statement: 64 rows of the shipped 5,012-row deliverable carry body-site terms the SME already rejected — roughly triple the count on the fix-first list.
conclusions.detail:
Discovered when the sme-rejected-body-site rule was added and the batch re-validated: blocker findings went 12 -> 76 across 75 rows, of which 64 are 위팔 or 엉덩이 (run 89cf8e323b73). The fix-first list carried roughly 21 (10 위팔 + 11 hip -> 엉덩이), counted by hand.

These were invisible because the rule that would have caught them could not fire. `severity` and `enforce` were documented in the rules file as independent switches but were not: find_violations skipped enforce:false rules, and validate_translations filtered them AGAIN at load. So a rule written to gate the deliverable without steering the prompt — exactly what this ruling needs, since a prior ablation found that PRESCRIBING native body sites hurts quality — was a silent no-op.

This is a deliverable finding independent of the ancestor work: it is 64 defective rows in what would have been sent to the SME, and the repair fixes none of them (they are pre-existing, not introduced, so the patch-safety gate deliberately leaves them alone). They need their own correction pass.

conclusions.statement: review_priority predicts SME rejection: on the blinded 120-row round-3 sample, reject rate rises 40% / 52.5% / 82.5% across low/medium/high tiers (linear-by-linear z=3.84, p=0.00012, pre-registered analysis).
conclusions.detail: The blinded, stratified 40/40/40 design was decided before the reviewer saw the file, so this is a clean validation: the priority score (automated detectors + sampling disagreement) can direct review effort. Caveat: the LOW tier still runs 40% not-acceptable, so the score triages rather than certifies — low priority must not be read as 'reviewed'. All 70 rejections are PARTIAL (0 WRONG): the residual defect mass is convention-level, not clinical.

conclusions.statement: The round-3 PARTIAL mass is dominated by systematic, rule-writable convention classes, and the two largest are NOT exemplar-pool-induced: 투시-유도하 over-application traces to our own now-superseded SME gold, and transluminal=혈관 경유 was output despite the pool overwhelmingly preferring 혈관내.
conclusions.detail: 70 PARTIAL / 0 WRONG. Classes: 투시 유도하 without source 'guidance' (~10 rows; the only pool support is 2 SME_gold_v1 rows the reviewer has now overruled — stale gold, which the SME lock would otherwise preserve); transluminal=혈관내 + cutting balloon=칼날 풍선 (~8 rows, prompt-induced against the pool); ~술 suffix policy (PT drops 술, synonym keeps it — here the pool DOES push the wrong way); plain X-ray must include 방사선; explicit word-order templates; ~40 term-level glossary rulings in her notes. Implication: deterministic rule/glossary/style-guide fixes reach most of the mass; adjudicated-gold rows must be update-able when the reviewer supersedes herself.

conclusions.statement: Reviewer prose rulings from round 3 convert directly to machinery: hip resolves from the RF2 procedure-site model (hip joint structure → 엉덩 관절/고관절, hip region → 엉덩이), limb keeps the 팔/다리/사지 split (팔다리 acceptable), and body-site register follows KMA policy — native form preferred with the Sino-Korean form carried as synonym.
conclusions.detail: Hip is machine-checkable: a detector that reads the concept's procedure-site attribute from RF2 and checks the Korean rendering against it, plus a repair pass. The register ruling means the deliverable should systematically carry both forms (native PT, Sino synonym) — 'if we have the native forms along with the Sino-Korean forms, we are safe.' Her own corrections are not uniformly native (상장간막동맥 over 위창자간막), so register remains term-by-term; carrying both forms is the safe invariant.

conclusions.statement: One deterministic fold-in of the round-3 rulings (style guide v6.1 + 8 source-conditional rules) moved the 120-row sample from 42.5% to 60.8% exact agreement with the reviewer's wording under the unchanged production cascade, eliminating every systematic convention class (0 hits on all 8 round-3 rules) without increasing escalation.
conclusions.detail: Run 274572a407ae: 38/70 PARTIAL rows now produce her correction verbatim (was 1/70); 35/50 ACCEPTABLE rows unchanged; ~10 more rows are variants she plausibly accepts. Residual error mass: word order on long multi-modifier terms (the natural GEPA target), glossary gaps, 3-4 minor new regressions, and reviewer self-inconsistency (hip is three-way inconsistent within her own return). Measures feedback ABSORPTION, not generalisation — rulings were derived from these rows, though corrections were not retrievable as exemplars.

conclusions.statement: The round-3 convention classes covered ~15% of the full deliverable (815 warning findings over 5,012 rows), and minimal-substitution repair cleared 97.7% of them in one pass (815→19) with zero new blockers and collisions unchanged — every residual finding sits on an SME-locked row whose adjudicated text predates the reviewer's own round-3 rulings.
